skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 60% ATK Direct DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 150% ATK Direct DMG to the target's entire row. Grants same-row allies (except himself) [Super Speed] when his speed is high enough. Places a [Counter] mark on all enemies, and inflicts [Energy Seal] on the target (seals 3 energy) while the mark holds.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Direct DMG 150% > 200% ATK to the target's row. [Super Speed] trigger threshold eased. Additionally buffs all allies with +30% ATK (2 rounds). [Counter] mark and [Energy Seal] (3 energy) unchanged.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains +20% HP. When entering battle, gains +60% Dodge. On taking fatal damage, triggers [Feign Death] and revives at 60% max HP, up to 3 times.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Dodge 60% > 70%. [Feign Death] revive HP 60% > 80% max HP. Revives 3 times.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Dodge 70% > 80%. Revives 3 > 4 times at 80% max HP.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: Gain 32% [Specialized Acceleration] at the start of battle. Before surrounding allies take action, they will trigger [Specialized Breakthrough] once on the main target (can only trigger once per round). ———- [Specialized Breakthrough]: Immediately cancel the target's [Unyielding] and increase attack power by 20% until end of this attack

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Specialized Acceleration 32% > 40% Surrounding allies > ALL allies Attack power increase 20% > 30%

effects.desc: Shield ignores damage from certain attacks. Must be penetrated by Breakthrough or Charge/True DMG.
The revive/return mechanism is tied to the life of the ally, bringing the unit back into the match.
A counter mark whose class number gradually increases the user's direct counter damage to marked enemies.
Increases ally's speed to near deployer's speed (remains the same if ally is already faster).
